entities.summary: Jerome Williams, nicknamed "Junkyard Dog" or "JYD", is an American former professional basketball player active in the National Basketball Association (NBA) between 1996 and 2005. Williams played for the Detroit Pistons, Toronto Raptors, Chicago Bulls, and the New York Knicks.
